newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ dollar drifts down at close with Aust dollar.
newsitem.headline: NZ dollar drifts down at close with Aust dollar.

text.p: The New Zealand dollar drifted lower in line with a softer Australian dollar in holiday-affected Monday trade.
The Kiwi closed at US$0.7074/81, down from 0.7087/94 early in the session and was little-changed on the Trade-Weighted Index at 68.65.
Wellington was closed for its anniversary day holiday.
"It's been a very, very quiet day with virtually nothing going on," said one Auckland dealer.
"It's a thin market, with no-one really trading. The Aussie has been marked back so the Kiwi has come down in sympathy," he said.
Short term, support for the Kiwi is expected to hold at 0.7060, with upside limited to 0.7100.
The Trade-Weighted Index was little changed at 68.66.
